    suffixPayment(value: string) {
      if (!value) {
        return
      }
      const suffix = value.split('_')
      return suffix[0]

    getPaymentStatus(data: any) {
      if (data.type === 'BLOCK') return 'BLOCK'
      const completed = data.transactions?.filter((t: any) => t.status === 'COMPLETED').length || 0
      if (!Array.isArray(data.transactions) || data.transactions.length === 0) return 'NO_PAYMENT'
      if (completed === data.users_ids_count) return 'FULL_PAYMENT'
      return 'PARTIAL_PAYMENT'
    },
    getPaymentCardClass(data: any) {
      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#CFF8DF] text-[#07543C]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFD6DC] text-[#7A1020]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FFE5C2] text-[#7A4200]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#FFE5E9] text-[#7A1020] border border-[#EA2D4333]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },

      const classes: Record<string, string> = {
        FULL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#10B981]',
        NO_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
        PARTIAL_PAYMENT: 'bg-[#FB8C00]',
        BLOCK: 'bg-[#EA2D43]',
      }
      return classes[this.getPaymentStatus(data)]
    },
    isCompactEvent(event: any) {
      const start = moment(event.start)
      const end = moment(event.end)
      return end.diff(start, 'minutes') <= 30
    },
    getSportEmoji(sport: string) {
      const value = sport?.toLowerCase() || ''
      if (value.includes('padel') || value.includes('pádel')) return '🎾'
      if (value.includes('football') || value.includes('soccer') || value.includes('fut')) return '⚽'
      if (value.includes('beachvolley') || value.includes('beach volley') || value.includes('volley')) return '🏐'
      if (value.includes('tennis') || value.includes('tenis')) return '🎾'
      return '🏟️'
    },
    getPaymentEmoji(payment: string) {
      if (this.suffixPayment(payment) === 'BILLCENTRIX') return '💳'
      if (payment === 'CASH') return '💵'
      if (payment === 'YAPPY' || payment === 'NEQUI' || payment === 'DIGITAL_WALLET') return '📱'
      return '💰'
    },
    getPaymentMethodLabel(payment: string) {

    },
